title: carum amomum
intro: Carum amomum, commonly known as Indian cardamom or green cardamom, is a perennial herb native to India and Southeast Asia. It is valued for its aromatic seeds and leaves, which possess various health benefits such as digestive aid, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Carum amomum include its ability to soothe digestive issues, alleviate nausea and vomiting, and provide relief from respiratory problems like coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of Carum amomum include limonene, alpha-terpinyl acetate, and beta-pinene, which contribute to its medicinal and culinary uses.
